verdict.rationale: CRA's only documented programmatic channel is EFILE. Certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers can transmit returns system-to-system, including amended returns via ReFILE. Everything else in the pack is described as web e-services or portals with no API equivalent: BN registration via BRO, payments, enquiries, document submission and Represent a Client. No llms.txt or agent docs index is published. Missing for 10: a public API covering registration, payments, account management, document submission and notices; parity with the web UI; open developer access without certification gating; API documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: certified software plus an enrolled electronic filer transmit returns system-to-system

electronically file their clients' current and first seven prior years' income tax and benefit return information to the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) directly from their EFILE–certified tax preparation software
